interface.longDescription: Keep your ICP, offer, customer evidence and playbook progress across chats. Research markets, prepare sourced account briefs, run GTM playbooks and review acquisition economics in Codex. Local Markdown and JSONL, with connected tools using their own permissions. Learn more at https://gtm-brain.ai/.
